name: bld_edelstein_iterates_tendsto
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) (p : X) (hp : f p = p) (x : X) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => f^[n] x) Filter.atTop (nhds p)
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) (p : X) (hp : f p = p) (x : X), Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => f^[n] x) Filter.atTop (nhds p)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.top_tendsto_of_subseq_limits_unique (and complements Mathlib2.top_edelstein_unique_fixed_point): dist (f^[n] x) p is antitone with limit c; any subsequential limit b satisfies dist b p = c = dist (f b) p by continuity, forcing b = p by strict contraction; conclude by the subsequence criterion on the compact space.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X), (∀ (x y : X), x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) → ∀ (p : X), f p = p → ∀ (x : X), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => f^[n] x) Filter.atTop (nhds p)
